defect_location.notes: CVE-2018-1000001: realpath 向目的缓冲区之前写入（CVE 描述: confusion in the usage of getcwd() by realpath() which can be used to write before the destination buffer leading to a buffer underflow）。用户态等价重构（planted=true）。
